scientific_integrity: The displayed formulas follow from an explicit interpolation certificate with a proved degree bound, and the law from an elementary coupling. Finite computations do not substitute for those proofs. The relevant 1993 multiple-Franel-integral full text was not accessible, leaving a risk of implicit prior coverage.
scientific_limitations: Exact fourth moments are shown only for 3p with p prime at least five; the quantitative limiting distribution fixes the other prime q. No formula for arbitrary squarefree moduli and no optimality assertion for the convergence constant are claimed.
title: Exact fourth Delange moments for three times a prime and a semiprime discrepancy limit law
